purpose: Animate the 4 identity/style-lock stills with LTX-Video (image+text). Judge: same person, same visual style, motion only.

lock_preamble: IDENTITY AND STYLE LOCK FROM THE INPUT IMAGE. Keep the exact same person and the exact same visual style as the first frame. Do not redesign the face, body, clothing, or art medium. Only add natural motion described below.
